_comment: Pulled from the live tenant connection "source_mysql_e2e_local" (repsrc_mysql) and parameterized. buildMysqlGatewaySource() in deploy-to-qlik.js fills the {{placeholders}} from deploy config (dataGateway.id and dataConnections.mysql.{host,port,username,sslMode}). NOTE: a repsrc_mysql connect string carries NO database= parameter - unlike PostgreSQL, the schema is chosen per landing task, which is why MCG CRM Landing/sourceSelection.yaml needs its schema: key. Refresh with: node deploy/pull-connection-template.js "MCG CRM Database" mysql-source
